title: Record thermoelectric figure of merit in Bi1−xSbx achieved by 1-D Landau level quantization
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE00253B, Paper

Bin He, Xiaolong Feng, Dong Chen, Federico M. Serrano-Sanchez, Mohamed Nawwar, Haihua Hu, Urlich Burkhardt, Berit H. Goodge, Claudia Felser, Joseph P. Heremans, Yu Pan
The magnetic field significantly enhances the thermoelectric performance of Te-doped Bi88Sb12 by the quantum mechanical effect induced exotic density of states. By such enhancement, the best zT reaches 2.6, comparable to the current best results.
